table.oracle: expected values: reference interpreter, confirmed by the independent BigInt oracle (tools/corpus.ts) when the table was generated

programs.name: arith
programs.about: u32 arithmetic wraps mod 2^32; div and rem are total; shifts use the low five bits

programs.name: logic
programs.about: bool logic, comparisons (unsigned), select computes both arms

programs.name: array
programs.about: array values: get reduces the index modulo the length, set returns a copy

programs.name: record
programs.about: records: rec, at, put (a copy), records inside arrays and arrays inside records

programs.name: iterate
programs.about: fold and loop: zero trips, extras, early stop by predicate, aggregate state, nesting

programs.name: calls
programs.about: call chains and the call/ID shorthand, callee results feeding callers

programs.name: text
programs.about: text literals are arrays of UTF-8 bytes with escapes

programs.name: io
programs.about: io tokens order effects: read (0 when exhausted), write, puts, folds that thread the stream
